scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof is supplied, finite exact checks are supportive rather than certification, and no independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Extremum applies only to pure graded posets with at most two elements in each rank (and hence to pure width-two posets), not unrestricted posets. Historical ranked-poset implications remain a residual literature risk.
title: Sharp facet-gap extremizers among pure rank-thin posets
